story.text: 떠나는 날 아침, 캐리어를 정리하는 내 손이 왠지 느려졌다. 하늘은 묵묵히 짐을 나눠 들며 먼저 문을 나섰다.
story.reading: tteo-na-neun nal a-chim, kae-ri-eo-reul jeong-ni-ha-neun nae son-i waen-ji neu-ryeo-jyeot-da. ha-neul-eun muk-muk-hi jim-eul na-nwo deul-myeo meon-jeo mun-eul na-seot-da.
story.en: On the morning I was leaving, my hands packing the suitcase moved slower than usual, somehow. Haneul silently helped carry the bags and headed out the door first.

story.text: "역까지 안 와도 되는데." 내가 말하자, 그는 들은 척도 안 했다. "배웅은 끝까지 하는 거야, 원래." 결국 그는 개찰구 앞까지 따라왔다.
story.reading: yeok-kka-ji an wa-do doe-neun-de. nae-ga mal-ha-ja, geu-neun deul-eun cheok-do an haet-da. bae-ung-eun kkeut-kka-ji ha-neun geo-ya, won-lae. gyeol-guk geu-neun gae-chal-gu ap-kka-ji tta-ra-wat-da.
story.en: "You don't have to come all the way to the station." I said, but he didn't even acknowledge it. "Seeing someone off means seeing it through to the end, always." In the end, he followed me all the way to the ticket gate.

story.text: 열차 시간이 다가오자 그가 불쑥 말했다. "다음에 올 땐 미리 연락해. 스케줄 맞춰볼 테니까." 무심한 척했지만 진심이 느껴졌다.
story.reading: yeol-cha si-gan-i da-ga-o-ja geu-ga bul-ssuk mal-haet-da. da-eum-e ol ttaen mi-ri yeol-lak-hae. seu-ke-jul mat-chwo-bol te-ni-kka. mu-sim-han cheok-haet-ji-man jin-sim-i neu-kkyeo-jyeot-da.
story.en: As the train time drew near, he suddenly spoke up. "Next time you come, let me know ahead. I'll try to line up my schedule." He acted indifferent, but I could feel the sincerity.

story.text: "약속이다. 진짜 또 와야 돼." 나는 새끼손가락을 내밀었다. 그는 잠시 머뭇거리다 마지못한 척 손가락을 걸었다.
story.reading: yak-sog-i-da. jin-jja tto wa-ya dwae. na-neun sae-kki-son-ga-rag-eul nae-mil-eot-da. geu-neun jam-si meo-mut-geo-ri-da ma-ji-mot-han cheok son-ga-rag-eul geol-eot-da.
story.en: "It's a promise. You really have to come again." I held out my pinky. He hesitated for a second, then hooked his finger like he was doing it reluctantly.

story.text: "우리 이런 사이, 우정이라고 해도 되지?" 내가 장난스레 묻자, 그는 잠시 나를 빤히 보다 대답했다. "당연하지. 넌 이제 내 친구야."
story.reading: u-ri i-reon sa-i, u-jeong-i-ra-go hae-do doe-ji? nae-ga jang-nan-seu-re mut-ja, geu-neun jam-si na-reul ppan-hi bo-da dae-dap-haet-da. dang-yeon-ha-ji. neon i-je nae chin-gu-ya.
story.en: "Can I call this — us — friendship?" I asked, half-joking. He looked at me steadily for a moment before answering. "Of course. You're my friend now."

story.text: "이 우정은 영원히 갈 거야." 나는 웃으며 말했다. 그는 대답 대신 픽 웃고는, 손을 들어 내 머리를 가볍게 헝클어뜨렸다.
story.reading: i u-jeong-eun yeong-won-hi gal geo-ya. na-neun us-eu-myeo mal-haet-da. geu-neun dae-dap dae-sin pik ut-go-neun, son-eul deul-eo nae meo-ri-reul ga-byeop-ge heong-keul-eo-tteu-lyeot-da.
story.en: "This friendship's going to last forever." I said with a smile. Instead of answering, he just smirked and reached out to ruffle my hair lightly.

story.text: 열차가 플랫폼을 떠날 때, 창밖으로 손을 흔드는 그가 점점 작아졌다. 오랜 친구와 함께한 열흘이, 오래도록 마음에 남을 것 같았다.
story.reading: yeol-cha-ga peul-laet-pom-eul tteo-nal ttae, chang-bakk-eu-ro son-eul heun-deu-neun geu-ga jeom-jeom jag-a-jyeot-da. o-raen chin-gu-wa ham-kke-han yeol-heul-i, o-rae-do-rok ma-eum-e nam-eul geot gat-at-da.
story.en: As the train pulled out of the platform, he grew smaller and smaller outside the window, waving. Ten days spent with an old friend — I had a feeling they'd stay with me for a long, long time.

words.example_en: I'll come visit again next time.
I saw my friend off at the airport.
